implemented: Non-running QUEUED/AWAITING_INPUT/AWAITING_APPROVAL cancellation finalizes atomically; running tasks retain intent-only cancellation.
Legacy pending non-running cancellation finalizes on authorized retry, retaining original requestedAt and new completedAt; repeated terminal requests add no effects.
Worker terminal FAILED/CANCELLED child outcomes atomically append parent timeline and RESULT references; nonterminal retry adds no terminal callback.
Unknown retained artifact counts are omitted from failure/cancellation callbacks.
nativeControls: Immediate cancellation of each non-running status passes actual SQL guards and readback.
RUNNING remains intent-only; legacy request timestamp and single transition evidence survive retry.
Existing26-cancelled-candidate starvation and thrown-claim cancellation persistence controls still pass.
Completed/failed/worker-cancelled children retain exact parent notifications and unchanged parent execution snapshot; stale/duplicate completion remains fenced.
limits: Disposable native PostgreSQL with synthetic credentials and deterministic bridge adapters only; no provider, production or external effects.
Immediate human cancellation of a non-running child does not yet emit the new parent terminal RESULT callback; its own canonical cancellation timeline is retained.
No automatic parent requeue, dependency wake-up, authority change, bulk cleanup, deployment or schema change.
